notablePrerequisites: Norritt does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Cerulean Wisps for {U} targeting Kiki-Jiki, making Kiki-Jiki blue.
Tap Kiki-Jiki to make a copy of Norritt.
Tap the copy to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat for infinite tapped tokens with haste.
Cast To Arms! to untap your tapped tokens.
